push.title: W 3-2 vs Boko harma | You: 8.9 (5th best match performance of the season)
push.body:
Mercy me, BellyTb1. An 8.9. That one goes in the scrapbook, page one.

THE GOOD
+ A hat trick against Boko harma. That's a finish they'll replay at the club banquet.
+ Man of the Match, your 8th for us. That's a captain's performance, armband or not.
+ 8.9: your 5th best match performance of the season. Remember how that felt.
+ Win against Boko harma, 3-2. Somebody cue the music.

THE BAD
- 65% passing (11 of 17). Real talk: If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.
- Won 0 of 3 tackles (down from your usual 56%). Next match: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away. Keep it simple, keep it sweet.
- 2 goals conceded: -0.1. Like leaving the porch light on all day. Small, but it adds up.
- Key passes: 0. One gear up gets you to 2+.

Practice plan: Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.

Between you and me, BellyTb1: The other team puts their shorts on one leg at a time too.

I'll be smiling about that one all week. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
A 7.4, PhogsToffees. You did the little things, and the little things added up.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at Boko harma's goal. You weren't shy, and shy doesn't score.
+ 3 key passes. That's playmaking, plain and simple.
+ You and BellyTb1 play like you've known each other since kindergarten.
+ Tackles attempted 6, up from your usual 3. Proof you've got another gear.
+ Better pass accuracy than any of their humans (83% vs their best 82%). Pure hustle, and hustle is free.

THE BAD
- 1 of 3 shots on target. Focus point: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
- Missed tackles 6, up from your usual 3. Note to self, from me to you.
- 0.4 under your norm. Rest up, reset, return.
- Worst passes attempted of your 3 matches this session (30). Start here: Drift into the half-space between their midfield and defense. It's the hardest spot to mark.

Practice prescription: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

PhogsToffees, from me to you: Run like the ice cream truck just turned the corner.

Good effort, better days ahead. - Coach Lasso
